title: Firewall IPv6 operation parity and global-options validation hardening
acceptance_criteria: IPv4 and IPv6 firewall batch/reorder endpoints preserve HTTPException status codes (400-level errors are not converted to 500).
IPv6 firewall batch endpoint accepts legacy op names for ICMP and TTL while mapping to canonical icmpv6/hop-limit methods.
Frontend IPv6 firewall rule create/update flows send canonical icmpv6 and hop-limit operation names.
Firewall rule create/edit UI labels packet modification field as Hop Limit for IPv6.
Firewall global-options page performs client-side timeout range validation before save.
Firewall global-options update endpoint validates enum and timeout fields and returns 400 for invalid payloads.
Regression tests cover new firewall batch semantics and global-options validation behavior.
assumptions: TTL field is kept in shared UI model for compatibility, but maps to hop-limit on IPv6 command generation.
Timeout lower bound is enforced as 1 second to prevent invalid conntrack values from reaching commit.
Browser e2e smoke remains out-of-gate on this host until Playwright shared libraries are installed.

tasks.notes: Added HTTPException passthrough, IPv6 op aliases, and global-options payload validation.
Updated IPv6 operation names/Hop Limit labeling and added client-side timeout validation in global-options UI.
Added regression tests for HTTP error semantics, IPv6 legacy alias compatibility, and global-options validation.
Manual review pass pending before moving to next backlog slice.
